items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: The performance of consumer discretionary businesses is closely linked to economic cycles. This sensitive demand profile can cause the industry to underperform when macro uncertainty enters the fray, and over the past six months, its 1.5% return has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 12.1% gain.
